properties.name: `reflow2_check.py` gains a ROUND TRIP check: export → import → re-export, compared structurally, so a committed export that cannot be read back is caught. The only probe that sees this class — content_hash, the lineage chain and sync_status all compare the export to ITSELF and never run the importer. dev_storyflow's export had been unrestorable for four days with every one of those green.
